    public static int Run(int input) => input < 1100 ? RunSigned(input) : RunUnsigned(input - 1100);

    private static int RunSigned(int input)
    {
        var narrow = sizeof(nint) == 4;
        var leftIndex = (input % 100) / 10;
        var rightIndex = input % 10;
        var left = narrow ? (nint)SignedValues32[leftIndex] : (nint)SignedValues64[leftIndex];
        var right = narrow ? (nint)SignedValues32[rightIndex] : (nint)SignedValues64[rightIndex];
        var expectedError = narrow ? SignedErrors32[input] : SignedErrors64[input];
        try
        {
            var result = (input / 100) switch
            {
                0 => unchecked(left + right),
                1 => unchecked(left - right),
                2 => unchecked(left * right),
                3 => checked(left + right),
                4 => checked(left - right),
                5 => checked(left * right),
                6 => left / right,
                7 => left % right,
                8 => left & right,
                9 => left | right,
                _ => left ^ right,
            };
            if (expectedError != 0) return -1;
            var expected = narrow ? (nint)SignedResults32[input] : (nint)SignedResults64[input];
            return result == expected ? 42 : -2;
        }
        catch (OverflowException) { return expectedError == 1 ? 42 : -3; }
        catch (DivideByZeroException) { return expectedError == 2 ? 42 : -4; }
    }

    private static int RunUnsigned(int input)
    {
        var narrow = sizeof(nuint) == 4;
        var leftIndex = (input % 100) / 10;
        var rightIndex = input % 10;
        var left = narrow ? (nuint)UnsignedValues32[leftIndex] : (nuint)UnsignedValues64[leftIndex];
        var right = narrow ? (nuint)UnsignedValues32[rightIndex] : (nuint)UnsignedValues64[rightIndex];
        var expectedError = narrow ? UnsignedErrors32[input] : UnsignedErrors64[input];
        try
        {
            var result = (input / 100) switch
            {
                0 => unchecked(left + right),
                1 => unchecked(left - right),
                2 => unchecked(left * right),
                3 => checked(left + right),
                4 => checked(left - right),
                5 => checked(left * right),
                6 => left / right,
                7 => left % right,
                8 => left & right,
                9 => left | right,
                _ => left ^ right,
            };
            if (expectedError != 0) return -1;
            var expected = narrow ? (nuint)UnsignedResults32[input] : (nuint)UnsignedResults64[input];
            return result == expected ? 42 : -2;
        }
        catch (OverflowException) { return expectedError == 1 ? 42 : -3; }
        catch (DivideByZeroException) { return expectedError == 2 ? 42 : -4; }
    }
}
